title: Get Hired Before Christmas: LinkedIn Job Search Tips and Google Hacks to 10X Your Job Search Fast!
description:
These are the exact LinkedIn job search tips, Boolean search strategies, and Google hacks people use to get hired fast,  even during the holidays ,and they work for any industry or experience level.

Want a job before Christmas? This video walks you step-by-step through the most effective job search shortcuts I’ve used for 20 years, helping job seekers get hired quickly. You’ll learn how to save hours, avoid ghost postings, and go directly to real recruiters and decision makers in just a few clicks.

Here’s what you’ll learn:

• LinkedIn job search tips that show you, real recruiters fast
• Boolean search tricks that filter out ghost job postings
• Google search hacks that surface real jobs instantly
• A strategy that takes you straight to the hiring decision makers
• A rapid company research method that lets you prep in minutes
• Tools most job seekers don’t even know exist

If you want to speed up your job search and skip the overwhelm, this video will give you a major edge.

Subscribe to @kirchnercareers for more job search strategies that work, fast.
